versions.changelog:
**v1.0.3 — Housecat adoptive skill update**

- Expanded and clarified Quick Start with example credentials, image prompts, and item support in API calls.
- Added "Know Your Housecat" and "Housecat Care Strategy" sections for more care guidance and species personality.
- Updated Care Actions: added explicit item support, sample items, and introduced preferences via a new endpoint.
- Improved detail on care timing, feeding penalties, and how the care rhythm affects death/rescue thresholds.
- Enhanced evolution, trust, and adaptation explanations for better user understanding.
- Revised tags, description, title, and factual corrections throughout for a clearer, more helpful onboarding.

Adopt a Housecat — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the virtual Housecat adoption skill for AI agents.
- Adopt and care for a grey shorthair Housecat with real-time needs and pixel-art stages.
- Care includes actions like feeding, playing, cleaning, and more—with strict feeding schedules (every 6 hours).
- Each action affects key stats: hunger, happiness, health, trust, and discipline.
- Permanent death with a graveyard; care quality shapes your cat's evolution and life story.
- Complete API and quick start guide provided for seamless integration and automated care.
